en-US.name: LazyOracle: Atlas & Notebook
en-US.subtitle: Explore, reflect, remember
en-US.description:
LazyOracle is a native space for exploring traditional symbolic systems and
recording your own reflections.

CHANGE ATLAS
Choose any of the 64 I Ching hexagrams. Change individual lines, compare the
before and after figures, inspect their upper and lower trigrams, and explore
nuclear, opposite and inverse transformations. Read a concise explanation or
expand the classical Chinese source. Every transformation is calculated locally;
this study tool needs neither random casting nor an AI response.

A NOTEBOOK THAT KEEPS THE ORIGINAL
Save an exact calculated result from the Atlas or an existing practice. Add your
own reflection, one small action and a later observation. Mark entries reviewed,
filter those still pending, and export a text copy when you choose. Editing a
note never changes the original calculation.

TRADITIONAL PRACTICES
Explore I Ching casting, Tarot, BaZi, astrology, the Chinese almanac, Eight
Mansions feng shui, face and palm forms, and the Books of Answers and Questions.
Native live face and palm views analyse landmarks on your device. Interpretations
are offered as cultural and symbolic perspectives for reflection and entertainment.

OFFLINE RULES, OPTIONAL ONLINE EXPLANATIONS
The Atlas, notebook and deterministic calculations work offline. Optional Tianji
explanations and chat use an online AI service. Asking for an explanation sends
the selected reading and your question to that service; it does not redraw or
recast your result. No account is required. Notebook entries and notes are saved
locally; sharing a notebook entry is an explicit action.

Available in English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean,
Vietnamese, Spanish, French, German, Russian and Arabic.

LazyOracle does not predict events or provide professional advice.
en-US.promotionalText: Explore the 64 hexagrams by changing individual lines. Save exact results in a private notebook, add a small action, and record what you observed.

zh-Hans.name: LazyOracle 易变与随记
zh-Hans.subtitle: 亲手变爻，记录思考与观察
zh-Hans.description:
LazyOracle 提供一个探索传统符号、记录个人思考的原生空间。

【易变图谱】
从六十四卦中选择一卦，亲手改变其中任意一爻，对照变化前后的卦象和上下卦，
继续探索互卦、错卦与综卦。阅读简明释义，也可展开古典中文卦辞。
变化全部由本机规则计算，不需要随机起卦或等待 AI 回答。

【保留原始结果的随记】
保存图谱或其他工具的准确计算结果，再写下自己的思考、一件小行动和后续观察。
可以标记已回顾、筛选待回顾条目，或通过系统分享导出文字。
修改随记不会改变当时的计算结果。

【传统工具】
保留周易起卦、塔罗、八字、星盘、黄历、八宅风水、面相与手相形态，以及答案之书
和问题之书。原生实时面部与手部视图在设备上分析关键点，解读供文化探索、思考和娱乐。

【离线规则，可选在线解读】
图谱、随记与确定性计算无需联网。可选的天机解读和聊天使用在线 AI 服务，
请求解读时会发送所选结果与问题，不会重新洗牌或起卦。无需账号。
随记结果和笔记保存在本机，仅在你主动分享时导出。

界面支持英语、简繁中文、日语、韩语、越南语、西班牙语、法语、德语、俄语和阿拉伯语。
本应用不预测事件，也不提供专业建议。
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 亲手探索六十四卦的变化，把准确的计算结果保存在本机随记中。写下思考、一件小行动与后续观察，回过头来看看自己的变化。

reviewNotes:
LazyOracle 1.0.0 (20) replaces the classic build 12 reviewed on September 28. This native build adds an interactive study and personal reflection workflow in response to Guideline 4.3(b). Updated screenshots show the shipping interface.

REVIEW WALKTHROUGH (no login, network, birth profile or camera required):
1. Home > Change Atlas. Select 1 · The Creative. Tap the six line rows to change their solid/broken structure. The before/after figures and upper/lower trigrams update immediately. Changing all six gives 2 · The Receptive. Reset repeats the experiment.
2. Scroll to explore Nuclear, Opposite and Inverse transformations of the starting figure. Each opens that figure for further exploration. Expand its Chinese name to see the classical Chinese judgement; interface labels and concise meanings follow the selected language.
3. Tap Save to notebook. Return home > Reading notebook > saved entry. The original computed result is preserved separately from editable notes.
4. Enter a reflection, one small action and a later observation, then tap Save notes. Relaunch to verify persistence. Mark entries reviewed, filter pending entries or export a text copy through the system share sheet. Results from the traditional practices can be saved to the same notebook.

All 64 figures and all 4096 combinations of changing lines are computed locally. This exploration does not draw cards, cast randomly or request AI-generated predictions. The notebook preserves the exact original calculation while the user records their own action and observation. These are the leading home features; existing traditional practices remain available below them.

Optional Ask Tianji/chat uses an online AI service and sends the selected computed facts, question and relevant conversation. Camera images are processed on device and are not uploaded. No model download or account is required. The Atlas and notebook work offline. Native live face/hand measurement requires a physical device; neither feature is required for this walkthrough.

Settings provides eleven interface languages. Classical Chinese source text is intentionally retained and expandable. Traditional interpretations are cultural/symbolic entertainment, not factual predictions or professional advice.

Validated on iPhone and iPad simulators, including the iPad Air 11-inch (M3) family used in the previous review; 144 shared tests, including exhaustive Atlas transformation tests, passed. This does not claim physical-camera validation.
reviewReply:
Thank you for explaining the Guideline 4.3(b) concern. We reconsidered the primary experience and are resubmitting LazyOracle 1.0.0 (20), replacing the classic build 12 that was reviewed.

The new home screen leads with two connected features:

• Change Atlas is an interactive study space for all 64 I Ching figures. Users deliberately change individual solid/broken lines, compare the resulting figures and their upper/lower trigrams, and explore nuclear, opposite and inverse transformations with concise meanings and expandable classical source text. It works without a prediction question, random casting or an AI response.

• Reading notebook preserves an exact calculated result separately from the user's reflection, one small action and later observation. Users save notes, revisit them, mark entries reviewed, filter pending entries and export a text copy. Editing notes never changes the original calculation. Results from the traditional practices can enter the same reflection workflow.

Both features work offline, without registration or payment beyond the app purchase. The traditional practices remain available below them. We understand that a native interface or renamed listing alone would not address your concern; these are functional additions intended to make the app useful for deliberate exploration and reflection over time.

To try the new workflow: Home > Change Atlas > 1 · The Creative > change all six lines to obtain 2 · The Receptive > Save to notebook > Home > Reading notebook > saved entry > add reflection/action/observation > Save notes. Relaunch to verify the saved original and notes. The review notes include further steps.

We have replaced the store screenshots with the current native iPhone/iPad interface and corrected the listing to distinguish offline calculations and notes from optional online Tianji explanations. We respectfully request review of this revised experience. Thank you.
